title: Fix issue when integrate with json-editor v2.8.0
body:
Fixes #2171 

Hi @IanMayo, I just made a temporary fix to get it working, to support custom editor like location I need to spend more time to research. The class `AbstractEditor.extend` no longer exists.

Thanks for this @philb89 - is there a particular StoryBook I can use to view the new editor, is it via `yarn develop`?

> Thanks for this @philb89 - is there a particular StoryBook I can use to view the new editor, is it via `yarn develop`? Hi @IanMayo , currently not, I think we should remove this block first Then we can create a new storybook for the location editor 🤔

> currently not, I think we should remove this block first

Ok, but I _think_ we still need some processing like that.  We need to store the current GeoJSON data in the form (somewhere - maybe in the `location-editor`, or `DOM`), and we need to re-format the GeoJSON in human-readable form. 

We have these requirements. When the form contains a `location-editor`:
1. store the `PlannedActivityGeometry[]` JS array 
2. call a `render` function to convert the array to human readable `<ul>` list, display this as read-only in the `div`
3. provide an `Edit` button, when the form is editable
4. when the `Edit` button is clicked, provide the raw `PlannedActivityGeometry[]` array to the callback
5. when `Save` is clicked during location edit, store the new `PlannedActivityGeometry[]`, and re-do the `Render` function
6. when `Save` is clicked for the JSON-Editor, push the `current` value of of `PlannedActivityGeometry` back into the location field of the results object.

Note: this isn't relevant for this immediate issue, but note that in the future, we may have a table of `location` objects to edit.  So, we'll get this sorted first, and in the future come up with a way of the form containing multiple rows that contain a location-editor.  The drop-down in the below image will be replaced with a new `location-editor` with an `edit` button.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/209322155-1c0936b1-e9d1-456b-b180-1a7e1dcb68f9.png)

issues.title: Bug in `develop` - JSONEditor not found
issues.body:
Aaah, err, I think I've introduced a bug into develop, while integrating the new location-editor code.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/208494616-54b86bcc-2afd-48ca-a608-983d212fdc41.png)

Steps to reproduce:
- run `develop` branch
- log in as `MTG-1`

It looks like we have this new method of referring to JSONEditor, but JSONEditor is undefined in the above issue:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/208495113-91aff4a3-d073-499c-9b76-88b23815a7e3.png)

Note: as I look at the codebase, there are quite a few instances of `JSONEditor.defaults`, rather than `JSONEditor.JSONEditor.defaults`.  Could we investigate which is the correct pattern to use?
